title: Unexplained vertical bedrock shafts beside the Khafre causeway
summary: Jeffrey tells of Unexplained vertical bedrock shafts beside the Khafre causeway, about Dynastic era to present at Egypt (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: So, there's also no good archaeological explanation for what those shafts are for. From from the pharaonic burial perspective, archaeology and Egyptology does not have a good explanation for those vertical bedrock shafts adjacent to the causeway.

plain: A researcher named Jeffrey tells podcast host Jesse Michels about vertical shafts cut into the bedrock beside the Khafre causeway, the ancient stone walkway leading to the pyramid of the pharaoh Khafre at Giza in Egypt. He says archaeologists and Egyptologists have no good explanation for them as part of royal burial practice. He brings them up as possible evidence of something hidden beneath the pyramids, which the episode frames as an energy system.
